_verification_profiles: nativeVerify describes the legacy native wrapper/CLI inspection report; CLI exits 1 because its overall valid verdict is fail-closed. coverageReport describes the existing exact-byte inspection used by the public WASM handle and compiled MCP handler; the MCP result envelope keeps top-level valid false, but the public MCP Agreement workflow is currently unavailable under its privileged-profile fence. verify retains historical lower-level portable verifier metadata, not the public WASM handle contract. No mathematical success in any profile is an authorization or human-approval verdict.
